helpSupport.description: This section is currently under development. Soon you will find a searchable knowledge base, FAQs, and direct support channels.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: How do I create a new cargo or transport order?
faq.a1: Go to the dashboard, choose “Create cargo” or “Create transport”, fill in the route, dates and details, then publish.
faq.q2: Can I edit an order after publishing?
faq.a2: Yes. Open “My orders”, choose the order, click “Edit”, adjust the fields and save.
faq.q3: Why don’t I see regions or cities?
faq.a3: Regions and cities load after you pick a country. If the list is empty, try another country or refresh the page.
faq.q4: How do I move my order higher?
faq.a4: Open “My orders”, choose the order and tap “Raise” to push it up in the list.
faq.a5: Tap the star on a card. If it’s filled, the order is in favorites and will stay after reload. Tap again to remove.
faq.q6: What if I forgot my password?
faq.a6: Use “Forgot password” on the login page, enter your phone, get the code and set a new password.

create.howItWorksTitle: How does a reverse auction work?
create.howItWorksText:
You set the maximum price — this is the ceiling no carrier can bid above.
Carriers compete by offering lower and lower prices.
The carrier with the lowest bid at the end of the tender wins.
If two carriers bid the same price, the earlier bid wins.
